messages:
inc-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — Dedicated pool 'meander-labs-prod' GPU saturation detected. Severity: P1. Queue length: 420. GPU util: 99%. Link: https://infra.metrics/pool/meander-labs-prod :rotating_light:

sophie (oncall): acked. stepping in. starting quick triage. pulling timestamps + recent deploys.

liam (sre): seeing spike ~09:02 UTC, sustained. All pods pinned to v2-model-large. No recent infra deploys. Could be customer workload spike.

maya (solutions): oncall pinged me — customer is on-call too. ben, can you reach out to meander SRE and ask if they pushed a batch job?

ben (acct-eng): calling now, DMing phone. they confirm a scheduled evaluation job kicked at 09:00 and ramped quickly. They didn't expect that many concurrent sessions.

sophie (oncall): runbook recommends: 1) consider emergency burst 2) toggle model-fallback 3) rate-limit/queue cutoff. Given single-tenant pool, eviction not an option. Suggest: enable temporary GPU burst (+scale), and apply soft quota to reduce new sessions.

raj (infra-ops): can add 4x A100s from spare pool to this dedicated pool for ~30m with approvals. Command: ``rbctl pool modify --name meander-labs-prod --add-gpus 4 --reason "emergency-burst"``. Needs approval from ops-lead.

liam (sre): also prepare traffic mitigation: route low-priority model calls to quantized variant: ``route: meander-labs/* -> model: v2-model-large-qat if latency ok``. That drops perf but reduces GPU memory by ~40%.

ben (acct-eng): meander SRE on call approves temporary scale but wants status updates. They're okay with model fallback for non-critical flows.

sophie (oncall): contacting ops-lead @rajesh for approval now. tagging #exec-ops for visibility.

raj (infra-ops): approved via DM. executing burst now. executing: ``rbctl pool modify --name meander-labs-prod --add-gpus 4 --duration 60m`` — applying.

inc-bot: Action logged: burst_added by raj (infra-ops). Pool capacity increased by 4 GPUs at 09:12 UTC.

liam (sre): monitoring... queue length dropping from 420 -> 85 over 90s. GPU util down to 72%. Good signal.

maya (solutions): I've sent configuration snippet to meander: enable fallback for non-SLAs and lower concurrent session allowance temporarily. They confirmed applying client-side rate limit.

ben (acct-eng): meander noticed reduced error rate, their app latency improved. They thanked the team and asked for postmortem.

sophie (oncall): marking incident mitigated. Actions: 1) bursted +4 GPUs 2) enabled model fallback for low-priority routes 3) applied temporary client quotas. Next: run RCA with meander, verify scheduled-job throttle, recommend autoscale policy or pre-warm windows.

raj (infra-ops): scheduled follow-up: ticket INFRA-4821 for permanent autoscale guardrails + spare-pool reservation for enterprise tenants.

liam (sre): logs/snippets for RCA: ```metrics: gpu_mem_used[]; events: meander-job-start 2024-11-07T09:00; requests_by_model: v2-model-large=98%``` — saving artifacts under /incidents/4213456789/artifacts.

meander-support-bot: Meander support confirms they will throttle scheduled runs and coordinate future pre-warm requests.

sophie (oncall): closing loop. If anything regresses reopen thread. thanks all :thumbsup:
